pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae Ia q.13 a.11 (Exodus 3,13-14)
pairs.question: Si dixerint mihi: Quod est nomen eius? quid dicam eis?
pairs.answer: Sic dices eis: Qui est misit me ad vos.
pairs.derivation: From the Sed contra of Article 11, which quotes Ex. 3,13-14. Dropped the asking-narration framing 'Sed contra est quod dicitur Ex. 3,13-14, quod Moysi quaerenti,' before the question, and the speech tag 'et respondit ei Dominus:' before the answer. Moses's utterance is kept contiguous (the conditional 'Si dixerint mihi' through the interrogatives 'Quod est nomen eius? quid dicam eis?') to supply setup; first word capitalized. The Lord's reply is the genuine answer naming God ('Qui est misit me ad vos') and ends at the full stop; the following authorial 'Ergo hoc nomen Qui est...' is excluded.
